scope_note: Read-only index of saved evidence. These values are historical experiment results, not live backend measurements or a prediction of PP1 marks.

logics.name: AI venue understanding
logics.evidence: Local V3 ResNet18 U-Net structural segmentation and V3 opening YOLO run on uploaded PNG/JPEG; outputs remain source-linked candidates pending review.
logics.limits: Independent real-venue accuracy and metric geometry are not established.

logics.name: Evidence-qualified metric Spatial Twin
logics.evidence: Strict source, calibration, geometry, evidence and review gates; controlled metric-Twin registration succeeds.
logics.limits: KNOX and Ravenswood lack genuine measured/reviewed evidence; no real-source optimization.

logics.name: Event requirement-to-scene intelligence
logics.evidence: Four profile families compile explicit function/object demand; actual layout search is supported for the declared controlled Wedding scope.
logics.limits: Non-Wedding profiles are specifications only; full inventory and stock movement are unsupported.

logics.name: Historical S-GCN preference intelligence
logics.evidence: Graph and data collection/evaluation design documented.
logics.limits: No verified trained S-GCN, genuine historical preference labels or independent preference evaluation.

logics.name: Weather and safety context
logics.evidence: Controlled geometry exclusions, containment and clearance checks are implemented.
logics.limits: No validated weather-consequence model, legal safety certification, or certified access/egress result.

logics.name: Multi-objective NSGA-II
logics.evidence: Actual local pymoo NSGA-II returns metric polygons and independently checked candidates for supported controlled Wedding cases.
logics.limits: No global-optimality guarantee; real venues and broad event-family search are unsupported.

logics.name: Evidence/authority-aware adaptive replanning
logics.evidence: Controlled reuse, authorized singleton revision, full-recompute fallback, refusal and pending cases execute.
logics.limits: Matched conventional methods reproduce tested decisions; novelty is not established. Authority is simulated/local, not authenticated.

logics.name: Explainable planner decision support
logics.evidence: Run/layout-bound numerical explanations, validation results, denials and SQLite history are available.
logics.limits: Human usefulness and genuine planner feedback have not been evaluated.

models.name: V3 native-raster U-Net (ResNet18)
models.metric: Native held-out pooled mIoU 0.7904603037; 448-image qualified technical subset, split 320/64/64.
models.qualification: Source-family independence and broad real-venue generalization remain unverified.

models.name: V3 opening YOLO
models.qualification: External CVC development diagnostics show weak door transfer; do not merge protocols.

models.name: V2 event-object YOLO
models.metric: Synthetic test mAP50 0.91045; 157 clean scenes, 6,529 boxes.
models.qualification: Does not establish reliable physical venue inventory recognition.

models.name: V4 chair pilot
models.metric: AP50 0.83951 on a qualified published test with incomplete annotations.
models.qualification: Opt-in/experimental; not verified existing stock; disabled by default.
